suggestions: Promote the independent metadata-specific stale-completion, prior-advice-clearing, malformed/partial-field, authentication/join, privacy and mandatory-pin probes into permanent regression tests. Current changed tests cover the basic no-text acceptance and bridge drop behavior but not all these combinations.
review_findings: Only simultaneous absence of text and text_truncated selects metadata_only. Explicit null, empty objects, arrays, partial fields, mismatched keys, empty strings and truncated=true are not accepted.

Authentication remains before event handling in router.c:141-143; source-only credential is required. Ingest retains exact registered scope, latest complete physical row, sequence/revision monotonicity and attempt-ledger checks.

Accepted metadata advances revision/sequence and resets scope interpretation; context_put replaces the snapshot with has_interpretation false. It bypasses interpreter submission rather than synthesizing evidence.

Worker completion is serialized by the gateway lock and requires matching current revision at gateway_context.c:167. Independent delayed completion probe confirms old revision cannot restore advice after metadata revision advance.
Metadata does not reset pinned, owner, private_only, endpoint or model. Independent probes confirm opaque continuity pin and sensitive-source private authority remain effective.
Both bridge tests pass without skips in both builds; metadata completion returns 202 and adapter.dropped remains zero, with exactly one earlier text-driven interpreter request.

import copy
import time
import unittest
from test_gateway_context import GatewayContextTests, ContextSink

class Probes(GatewayContextTests):
    def meta(self, scope, n, revision):
        e = self.event(scope, n, revision)
        del e['event']['text']; del e['event']['text_truncated']
        return e

    def setup_fixture(self, c, s):
        self.configure(c, s); s.RequestHandlerClass = ContextSink
        c['context']['ttl_ms'] = 10000

    def probe_malformed_auth_and_join(self):
        with self.router(self.setup_fixture) as (p, sink):
            scope = self.open_scope(p); history = [{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
            self.turn(p, scope, 1, history)
            m = self.meta(scope, 1, 1)
            for auth in (False, True):
                self.assertEqual(self.request(p, path='/v1/context', body=m, auth=auth)[0], 401)
            wrong = copy.deepcopy(m); wrong['event']['api_request_id'] = 'wrong'
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p, wrong), 403)
            cases = [
                {'text': {'assistant_plan':'format'}},
                {'text_truncated': {'assistant_plan':False}},
                {'text':None,'text_truncated':None},
                {'text':{},'text_truncated':{}},
                {'text':[],'text_truncated':[]},
                {'text':{'assistant_plan':'format'},'text_truncated':{'assistant_plan':True}},
                {'text':{'assistant_plan':''},'text_truncated':{'assistant_plan':False}},
                {'text':{'assistant_plan':'format'},'text_truncated':{'reasoning':False}},
            ]
            for fields in cases:
                with self.subTest(fields=fields):
                    e = copy.deepcopy(m); e['event'].update(fields)
                    self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p, e), 400)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,m),202)
            self.assertEqual(self.request(p,path='/v1/context',body=m,source=True)[0],409)
            time.sleep(.15)
            self.assertFalse(getattr(sink,'interpreter_seen',False))

    def probe_stale_worker_completion(self):
        def edit(c,s):
            self.setup_fixture(c,s); s.interpreter_delay=1.0
        with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
            scope=self.open_scope(p); history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
            self.turn(p,scope,1,history)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.event(scope,1,1)),202)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+2
            while not getattr(sink,'interpreter_seen',False) and time.monotonic()<deadline:
                time.sleep(.005)
            self.assertTrue(sink.interpreter_seen)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.meta(scope,1,2)),202)
            time.sleep(1.25)
            history.append({'role':'user','content':'continue'})
            self.turn(p,scope,2,history)
            self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],'frontier')
            self.assertEqual(sum('response_format' in x[2] for x in sink.seen),1)

    def probe_existing_advice_cleared(self):
        with self.router(self.setup_fixture) as (p,sink):
            scope=self.open_scope(p); history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
            self.turn(p,scope,1,history)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.event(scope,1,1)),202)
            time.sleep(.3); history.append({'role':'user','content':'continue'})
            self.turn(p,scope,2,history)
            self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],'physical')
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.meta(scope,2,2)),202)
            time.sleep(.15); history.append({'role':'user','content':'continue'})
            self.turn(p,scope,3,history)
            self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],'frontier')
            self.assertEqual(sum('response_format' in x[2] for x in sink.seen),1)

    def probe_private_authority_survives(self):
        def edit(c,s):
            self.setup_fixture(c,s); c['compliance']={'enabled':True,'public_allowed':True}
        with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
            scope=self.open_scope(p); history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
            self.turn(p,scope,1,history)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.event(scope,1,1,'format alice@example.com')),202)
            time.sleep(.3); history.append({'role':'user','content':'continue'})
            self.turn(p,scope,2,history)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.meta(scope,2,2)),202)
            history.append({'role':'user','content':'continue'})
            self.turn(p,scope,3,history)
            self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],'physical')
            self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][0],'/v1/chat/completions')
            self.assertEqual(sum('response_format' in x[2] for x in sink.seen),1)

    def probe_mandatory_pin_survives(self):
        def edit(c,s):
            self.setup_fixture(c,s); s.tool_response=True
        with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
            scope=self.open_scope(p)
            body={'model':'alias','messages':[{'role':'user','content':'start'}],'max_tokens':128}
            self.assertEqual(self.request(p,headers=self.headers(scope,1),body=body)[0],200)
            self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.meta(scope,1,1)),202)
            sink.tool_response=False
            self.assertEqual(self.request(p,headers=self.headers(scope,2),body={**body,'model':'baseline'})[0],403)
